name: Electrical Measurements Training Module
shortDescription: An educational training module for learning fundamental electrical measurement techniques and interpreting electrical quantities.
description:
The AKI-E101 Electrical Measurements Training Panel introduces measurement of electrical quantities such as voltage, current, and resistance. Learners can study measurement instruments, circuit connections, and the basic principles used to observe and interpret electrical values.

The panel is intended for technical education and supervised laboratory study. Specific supplied instruments, measurement ranges, accuracy, and electrical requirements have not been verified; consult official product documentation before use.

name: Earth Fault Study Panel
shortDescription: An electrical safety training panel for studying earth-fault concepts and understanding protective measures in electrical installations.
description:
The AKI-E109 Earth Fault Study Panel introduces the educational principles of earth faults, grounding, fault-current paths, and electrical protection. It is intended to support supervised demonstrations and learning about electrical safety and protective systems.

Any practical use requires qualified supervision and appropriate safety procedures. Do not perform live-fault experiments without an approved, properly controlled laboratory setup.
